title: login mask plus show password
name: Login mask plus show password
rule: Login: mask by default + Show password (differs from creation-on-mobile). Two checks, not a fight.

citation.source: NN/g — A Checklist for Registration and Login Forms on Mobile

pass_when: Login password is masked by default and has Show password.
fail_when: Login shown-by-default with no mask, or masked with no Show.
overview: Login passwords mask by default and offer Show password.
apply_when: Password fields on login, separate from mobile creation defaults.
not_when: Applying mobile creation shown-by-default rules to login masking.
agent_hint: Mask login passwords by default and provide a Show password control.
description: On login, mask the password by default and provide a Show password control. Treat this as two checks, not a fight with creation-on-mobile defaults that may show by default. Pass when the login password is masked by default and has Show password. Fail when login is shown by default with no mask, or masked with no Show control available.
do_not_claim: Mobile creation shown-by-default as a contradiction of this row.
